title: Familia, relaciones y rutinas
communication_goal: Hablar de relaciones familiares y actividades que haces con otras personas.
situation: Explicas con quién vives, a quién visitas y qué haces con tu familia.

dialogue.speaker: Jorge
dialogue.english: I live with my wife and our daughter.
dialogue.spanish: Vivo con mi esposa y nuestra hija.

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.english: What do you do on Sundays?

dialogue.speaker: Jorge
dialogue.english: We usually visit my parents. We eat together.
dialogue.spanish: Normalmente visitamos a mis padres. Comemos juntos.

dialogue.speaker: Clara
dialogue.english: Does your son live with you too?

dialogue.speaker: Jorge
dialogue.english: No, he doesn't. He lives nearby.

explanation_es: Para hablar de convivencia usa live with: I live with my wife. Para actividades compartidas, We + verbo: We visit my parents; We eat together. Para preguntar por la persona que acompaña una acción usa Who do you live with? o Who do you visit? Con he/she recuerda la s: He lives nearby.
spanish_speaker_notes: Who do you live with? es una pregunta natural aunque termine en with.
Our significa 'nuestro/a' y their significa 'su' de ellos: our daughter, their son.
Visit no necesita to delante del familiar: visit my parents, no visit to my parents.
Together expresa que la acción se hace en compañía.

targets.text: I live with my wife and our daughter.

pronunciation.tip_es: En frases largas, agrupa a las personas primero y la actividad después.

reading.title: Jorge's Sunday
reading.text: Jorge lives with his wife and their daughter. On Sundays, they usually visit Jorge's parents and eat together. Their son does not live with them, but he lives nearby and visits often.
